title: A Digital Simulation Toolkit for Physics-Based Generation of Realistic Experimental Scanning Tunneling Microscopy Images
abstract: arXiv:2609.36639v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scanning Tunneling Microscopy (STM) is a widely used tool for characterizing surfaces of materials at the atomic scale, playing a crucial role in discoveries across condensed matter physics and materials science. Despite its extreme spatial resolution, STM is one of the most sensitive microscopy techniques and is highly prone to noise. While existing unsupervised denoising methods are very cheap to train, these are primarily focused on removing the noise with minimal recovery of key physical information. While supervised methods can offer superior performance, the major bottleneck is that a large amount of paired clean-noisy experimental images is required which are impractical to obtain. Thus, we developed a low-cost physics-driven digital toolkit to rapidly generate large volume of realistic STM images. Firstly, we simulate clean images from a chosen material system. translated_title: 用于基于物理生成真实实验扫描隧道显微镜图像的数字仿真工具包
translated_abstract: 扫描隧道显微镜（STM）是一种广泛用于在原子尺度表征材料表面的工具，在凝聚态物理和材料科学的众多发现中发挥着关键作用。尽管STM具有极高的空间分辨率，但它也是最敏感的显微技术之一，极易受到噪声干扰。现有的无监督去噪方法虽然训练成本很低，但主要专注于去除噪声，对关键物理信息的恢复很少。而有监督方法虽然性能更优，但主要瓶颈在于需要大量成对的干净-带噪实验图像，而这些图像在实践中难以获得。因此，我们开发了一个低成本、物理驱动的数字工具包，可以快速生成大量真实的STM图像。首先，我们从选定的材料体系中模拟出干净的图像；然后，利用已知的物理特性先验知识（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文开发了一个低成本、物理驱动的数字仿真工具包，可快速生成大量逼真的STM实验图像，为训练有监督去噪模型提供了实用的成对数据来源，突破了真实干净-带噪图像对难以获取的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a low-cost, physics-driven digital simulation toolkit that rapidly generates large volumes of realistic STM images, providing a practical source of paired training data to overcome the bottleneck of obtaining clean-noisy experimental image pairs.
